passages.text: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother.
passages.note: Old age and the wish to end life at home

passages.text: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid. The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me. In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
passages.note: Crying out from overwhelming fear and distress

passages.text: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
passages.note: Hope of light in a dark time
